description: This file defines the interface 'DocumentWritePlatformService' which specifies methods for creating, updating, deleting, and creating internal documents within the document management subsystem of Apache Fineract. It includes method signatures with authorization annotations, but no implementations.

classes.name: DocumentWritePlatformService
classes.description: An interface providing method signatures for document management operations such as creating, updating, deleting, and creating internal documents with security authorization annotations.

methods.name: createDocument
methods.description: Creates a new document based on provided command and input stream, subject to 'CREATE_DOCUMENT' authority.

methods.name: updateDocument
methods.description: Updates an existing document based on command and input stream, subject to 'UPDATE_DOCUMENT' authority.

methods.name: deleteDocument
methods.description: Deletes a specified document based on command, subject to 'DELETE_DOCUMENT' authority.

methods.name: createInternalDocument
methods.description: Creates an internal document with detailed parameters such as entity type and ID, file size, mime type, name, description, and filename, subject to 'CREATE_DOCUMENT' authority.
